where_to_look: 9 estimates on a defensive staple is the most crowded analyst surface of the day; the room is small. The one thing genuinely unpriced is the FY2027 guidance framework given with the full-year release, and specifically the Snacks segment's path after repeated resets

Sovos Brands (Rao's) is the growth asset carrying the whole story. Rao's velocity is measurable in Nielsen/IRI scanner data and in retailer shelf-space changes, and it is disclosed only in aggregate by Campbell's
The pre-recorded-remarks format means the only live information is the Q&A at 09:00 ET, which is 105 minutes after the release. That gap is itself a structural feature of how this name trades
Meals & Beverages volume elasticity: private-label share gains in condensed soup are visible in scanner data before they appear in Campbell's volume line
Leverage and the dividend: post-Sovos net debt/EBITDA and the interest-expense line constrain the guide more than the operating story does
Consensus $0.40 versus $0.62 a year ago is a large expected decline, so the bar is already low
